name: Charred Dungeon - Lava Strykewyrms
accessNote: Contains 12 Lava Strykewyrms in the Charred Dungeon beneath Charred Island. Requires 60 Sailing and deploying a rope to enter. The wider Charred Dungeon is multicombat and cannonable, but the Lava Strykewyrm sections are single-way and cannot be cannoned; safespotting requires a 9 or 10 tile attack range.
